contents.text: What is the maximum torque of an RX coupling of size 90?
The maximum torque of an RX coupling of size 90 is 2,800 N·m. The RX coupling sizes are: 50 mm, 70 mm, and 90 mm, with maximum torques of 450 N·m, 1,250 N·m, and 2,800 N·m, respectively.

RX flexible coupling: installation and alignment
# RX flexible coupling: installation and alignment
Permissible misalignment for RX couplings up to size 90:
RX coupling sizes
| Size | Maximum bore | Maximum torque | Elastomer element |
| 50 | 50 mm | 450 N·m | PN-5120-A |
| 70 | 70 mm | 1,250 N·m | PN-5170-A |
| 90 | 90 mm | 2,800 N·m | PN-5190-A |
For couplings above size 90, halve the permissible misalignment in the table above.
